services.name: Manitou Fall Flavor Sail
services.desc: >Come set sail for a spectacular 2-hour adventure on the sparkling waters of Grand Traverse Bay as we hoist the sails and let nature guide our path. Few activities are more exhilarating and calming as sailing on these freshwater seas. You can sit back and take it all in, or become involved with the sailing of the vessel, assisting the crew with the lines or perhaps even taking a turn at the wheel if conditions allow. This sail also features fall flavors from local favorite Moomers, voted the best ice cream on Good Morning America! >This 2-hour cruise will include: > • Breathtaking views 2 Hours · 12:30 pm - 2:30 pm & 3 pm - 5 pm · Fall Special

services.name: Nibi: Spirit of our Waters Sail
services.desc: >Nibi: The Spirit of our Water >Explore the connection the Anishinaabe, Grand Traverse Bay's ancestral residents, have to the Bay. Tera John, a Knowledge Carrier and Story Keeper from the Grand Traverse Band of Ottawa and Chippewa Indians will be our guide as Manitou sails across the waters that have been a vital resource since time immemorial. >On this 2-hour morning sail, you’ll enjoy: > • A history tour like none other in the area > • Connect with Grand Traverse Bay on a new local level > • Breathtaking views of the Traverse City shoreline and Old Mission Peninsula > • Views of the 2 Hours · 10 am - noon · Select Thursdays

services.name: Wings on the Water
services.desc: >Wings on the Water >Any time hawks and eagles soar above Manitou it makes the sail even more amazing. On this sail, the Skegemog Raptor Center will bring its famous educational birds aboard. In the past few years, we’ve seen more and more raptors along the shores of Grand Traverse Bay. Come sail with us and learn why they’ve returned and what it means. If we’re lucky, we’ll see one of the eagles that nest near our dock! What You Can Expect: >We will sail lower West Grand Traverse Bay, affording a good view of the Traverse City waterfront, including landmarks such as the historic Park 2 Hours · 10 am - noon · Select Thursdays

services.name: Manitou Moomers Ice Cream Sail
services.desc: >Sometimes the best thing to do in the afternoon is to just sit back and relax with the family or friends and enjoy a cool dish of ice cream. Take this summer ritual to the next level with a glorious sail and two scoops of the finest ice cream (voted #1 in America on Good Morning America!) you'll ever eat ... Moomers! >On this afternoon 2-hour sail, you’ll enjoy: > • The finest ice cream scoops available: Moomers > • Breathtaking views of the Traverse City shoreline and Old Mission Peninsula > • Views of the great historic Park Place Hotel > • A unique perspective of the Great Lakes Most Popular Manitou Sail! 2 Hours · 1pm & 3:30pm Daily

services.desc: >Traverse Tall Ship Company offers the premier day sailing experience in Traverse City! services.name: Manitou Brunch Cruise
services.desc: >Spice up your morning with a tasty beverage, a savory meal, and a glorious sail back in time! Greet the day on the bay with a full brunch, prepared right onboard the ship on our wood-fired cook stove, and a tasty eye-opening beverage. Choose from a spicy Bloody Mary, local L. Mawby sparkling wine Mimosa, Screwdriver, or non-alcoholic options. The first drink is included. Additional beverages may be purchased from the ship’s bar. >When making a reservation, please note any dietary restrictions. Can cater to vegetarians. services.name: Power Island Picnic Sail Aboard Manitou
services.desc: >Do you want to get away from it all, cast off the lines, and go explore Grand Traverse Bay’s hidden gem, all in just a single day? We have just the sail for you! We’re combining some of the best aspects of our summer and fall sails into one truly unique experience with our Power Island Picnic Sail. What to expect? >Check in at 9:00 am, board our flagship Manitou, and depart Discovery Pier at 9:30 am. >Once clear of the dock, guests are invited to help hoist Manitou’s sails. Once the sails are set, coffee and pastries will be served on deck in the open air as Manitou sails to Power 7 Hours · 10am - 5:00pm · June 15 & 29 · Sept. 23 & 30

blurb: Sailing the waters of Grand Traverse Bay is the highlight of any trip “up north.” Stretching north from Traverse City, the Bay’s crystal waters and tree-lined shores dazzle the eyes and soothe the spirit. The Bay is the best place to be in the summer, and the best way to experience its magic is by sailing aboard Traverse Tall Ship Company’s Schooner Manitou or Sailing Yacht Scout.
